identity.name: The Prepared Parent Project
identity.missionLine: Preparing Alabama parents. Strengthening Alabama families.
identity.audience: All parents, supporters, community partners, donors, and service organizations in Alabama

typography.webStack: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
typography.productionFallback: DejaVu Sans Bold for automated video until a licensed cross-platform brand font is bundled

visualSystem.cornerRadius: 12–18px on cards and calls to action
visualSystem.photography: realistic, diverse Alabama families and community contexts; avoid staged legal imagery
visualSystem.illustration: simple editorial shapes and icons; no clip-art look
visualSystem.contentSafeZones: keep essential text clear of Reel/Short app chrome and platform crop zones

legalCommunication.disclaimer: The Prepared Parent Project is not a law firm. Information provided is for general educational and informational purposes and is not legal advice.
legalCommunication.alabamaLegalGate: Alabama legal/court content may publish only after required authoritative-source and case-law review is complete.
